speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). The MRI findings of multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement, combined with right-sided weakness and ataxia, are classic for JC virus reactivation in immunocompromised patients.
